current_date: 29 October 2026 (index page 'last updated'); full planning checklist page last updated 16 October 2026
current_evidence: Grokbot's link is the live, current full planning checklist (last updated 16 October 2026), but Southwark's local list is a set of 12 per-application-type checklist web pages linked from the 'Planning checklists' index page (last updated 29 October 2026), so the link covers only one of them.

issues.detail: Grokbot read only the full planning checklist and treated it as the whole local list. Southwark publishes separate checklist pages for Householder, Full, Outline/Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Demolition in a conservation area, Prior approval, Lawful development certificate, Advertisement consent, Trees, Non-material amendment, Discharge of conditions and Removal/variation of conditions. As a result every other application type is marked '(none)' or filled with items copied from the full planning page. The workbook should point to the index page and use each type's own checklist.
issues.evidence: 'Planning checklists' index page (last updated 29 October 2026) links all 12 checklists, e.g. planning-checklists-householder-application, planning-checklists-listed-building-consent, planning-checklists-prior-approval-application, planning-checklists-advertisement-consent, planning-checklists-trees

issues.detail: Householder is marked 'No specific local requirements identified', but Southwark's householder checklist has many local items: CIL additional questions form (all application types); Fire safety strategy, or Reasonable exception form if there are no new dwellings or units, no new lift, no change to external materials and no change to communal evacuation areas; existing and proposed section drawings (altering ceiling or roof heights, basement works, roof extension, changing ground levels); roof plans (extension, roof lights, new outbuildings); levels or gradients plan (ground levels change relative to neighbours); Design and access statement (home in, or on the border of, a conservation area); Heritage statement (listed building); Daylight and sunlight impact assessment (extension or outbuilding might affect neighbours' sunlight); Archaeological desk-based assessment (groundworks in an archaeological priority area, or new basements, basement extensions or other extensive groundworks); Tree survey; Cycle parking information (changing or adding cycle parking); Basement impact assessment (new or altered basement); Noise impact assessment (noisy development such as an air conditioning unit or air source heat pump).
issues.evidence: Planning checklists - householder application, 'what you may need to also submit' (last updated 30 September 2026)

issues.detail: Listed building consent has only 'Heritage Statement', and that was taken from the full planning page. The LBC checklist also requires: Fire safety Reasonable exception form (all development); Fire safety strategy for listed building consent (London Plan D12(A)); existing and proposed drawings including cross-sections; Photographic condition study (where windows or doors are to be replaced); Detailed schedule of works and specifications (extensive restoration or alteration).
issues.evidence: Planning checklists - listed building consent (last updated 16 October 2026): 'Photographic condition study (windows and doors)', 'Detailed schedule of works and specifications'

issues.detail: Outline, Reserved matters, Demolition in cons area, Change of use - prior approval, Lawful development cert, Advertisement consent, Works to trees, Non-material amendment, Discharge of conditions and Variation of condition s73 are all marked '(none)', but each has its own Southwark checklist page that Grokbot never read. I did not check their contents within the call budget, so the specific missing items are unverified.

issues.detail: Full planning: Grokbot captured about 20 of roughly 80 items. Missing from the general sections: Fire safety strategy / Reasonable exception form (all; exception only if no new dwellings or units, lift, external materials or evacuation areas change); Fire statement (London Plan D12(B)); Affordable housing contribution (any scheme creating 1 or more homes, with exemptions); Accessibility drawings (ramp, gradient or Blue Badge parking); Affordable workspace strategy (>500 sq m employment space); Air quality neutral assessment (minor applications unless exempt); Archaeological evaluation report (groundworks in an APA, or extensive groundworks outside one); Basement impact assessment (new or extended basements); BREEAM pre-assessment (non-residential >500 sq m, including refurbishment or change of use); Business relocation strategy (may displace small or independent shops); Daylight and sunlight impact assessment (may affect light to neighbouring windows); Delivery and servicing management plan (all majors; minors in sensitive areas if an officer asks); Ecological impact assessment (tree works, mature or defective trees, derelict or allotment land, railway land, building modification or demolition especially roof voids); Foul sewage and utilities assessment (connection to foul or surface water sewers); Flood risk assessment (Flood Zone 2/3 including minor works and change of use, Zone 1 >1 ha, basement extensions, majors in critical drainage areas, Zone 1 with a notified critical drainage problem); Land contamination assessment (brownfield or known contaminated land); Marketing statement (loss of retail, employment, pub, community, cultural or health uses, with 2 years' marketing); Navigational risk assessment (tidal Thames, pier or jetty); Noise impact assessment (noise-sensitive development, noisy uses, significant plant); Photographs (all majors; listed building or conservation area setting; demolition); Refuse storage and collection strategy (residential or commercial waste generated); Schedule of accommodation (1 or more new units, house-to-flat conversions, all majors); Sport and leisure facilities assessment (redevelopment of existing facilities); Spot level and gradient plan (levels change relative to neighbours); Vehicle parking drawings (new or re-provided parking).
issues.evidence: Planning checklists - full planning application, 'what must be included' and 'what you may also need to submit' (last updated 16 October 2026)

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts describe the document's content, or are fragments, not when the item is required. Arboricultural/Tree survey: the excerpt is BS5837 content; the trigger is trees pruned or removed, on or near the site, or excavation or service runs near trees. Archaeological: 'The completed archaeological evaluation report must detail the results of the work' gives no trigger (groundworks in an APA, new basements or extensive groundworks). Cycle parking: the excerpt is store dimensions; the trigger is extra bedrooms, subdividing a home or converting to an HMO. Existing and proposed site levels/sections: the excerpt is basement drawing content; cross-sections apply to ground level changes (patios, decking, steps) and basement or loft conversions. Retail/Town centre impact: 'It must provide main town centre uses outside of town and local centres' is garbled; the trigger is buildings over 1,000 sq m providing main town centre uses outside centres. Viability: the excerpt is affordable housing contribution rates ('CIL Zone 1 and 2: 35% at £100,000 per habitable room'); the trigger is where affordable housing is required, a payment in lieu is due, or policy is set aside for viability. Ventilation: the excerpt is content mixed with BS4142 noise text; the trigger is non-residential schemes installing ventilation or extraction. Equalities impact statement and Lighting assessment excerpts are cut off mid-sentence.
issues.evidence: Full planning checklist: 'Tree survey: Required where trees are pruned or removed...'; 'Town centre impact assessment: buildings over 1,000 sq m...'; 'Viability appraisal: Required where affordable housing is required...'

issues.detail: Some requirements are mislabelled. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space / outdoor amenity' is really the Schedule of accommodation (its excerpt is about each unit and room meeting residential design standards); the daylight and sunlight impact assessment is a separate item that is missing. 'Self-build / custom build information' ('However, you will need to provide a self-build verification form') is the self-build exemption within the BNG item, not a free-standing requirement. 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' has only content text, with no trigger.
issues.evidence: Full planning checklist: 'Schedule of accommodation'; BNG section links the 'Self-build verification form'

issues.detail: Grokbot does not separate the page's general 'what you may also need' items (which apply to all full applications, including minor ones) from its 'Major planning application' section. Draft heads of terms, Energy statement, Town centre/Retail impact, SuDS pro forma and 3D model are listed under major applications but appear as general Full planning items. The repeated 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning' notes (Tree survey, Archaeology, BNG, Cycle parking, D&A, Lighting, Viability and others) are unnecessary, because the page is explicitly the full planning checklist. CIL additional questions form ('all application types') and Fire safety strategy / Reasonable exception form apply to householder and other types too, but sit only under Full planning or nowhere. Heritage statement sits only under LBC, but it also applies to full planning, and to householder applications for listed buildings.
issues.evidence: Full planning checklist headings: 'Full planning application: what you may also need to submit' vs 'Major planning application: what you may also need to submit'; CIL form 'Required for all application types'

issues.detail: The tab_items 'Submission rules' entry is 3D model file-format guidance (FBX/OBJ, under 128 MB, geo-located in GBOS, one layer), cut off mid-word ('If you amend the proposed develo'). It is process text, and the underlying requirement (3D model for all major applications) was never captured. The SuDS tab item repeats its heading twice ('Sustainable drainage systems (SuDS) pro forma Sustainable drainage systems (SuDS) pro forma'). Only 2 tab_items exist, while the reference row claims 21 required items.
issues.evidence: Full planning checklist: '3D model: Required for all major applications' (with a separate 3D model submission form)

issues.detail: Trigger excerpts include fee and process text. Draft heads of terms quotes S106 legal fees ('This is charged at £250 to £300 per hour'), and Viability quotes affordable housing payment-in-lieu rates. Neither describes a submission requirement.

summary: Grokbot's link is the live, current Southwark full planning checklist (updated 16 October 2026), but Southwark's local list is 12 per-application-type checklist pages and Grokbot read only this one. Householder, LBC and nine other types are therefore wrongly shown as having no local requirements. Even for full planning it captured only about a quarter of the items, many with content excerpts or garbled text in place of triggers, and it did not separate major from minor applications.
